_comment: UI-NFR-003 R-013/R-014/R-015/R-028 gzip budgets. Values are set just above the measured baseline (2026-07-11) so the gate starts green but fails on regression. Measured initial JS = 471.8 KB gzip (dominated by the eagerly-loaded i18n translation bundle, ~160 KB gzip). The R-013 aspirational target is 300 KB gzip; reaching it requires lazy-loading translations (tracked separately) — this gate locks the current baseline against silent growth in the meantime.
